subject: Business Administration
question_text: The classic marketing mix taught in BBA and MBA programmes consists of which four elements?
explanation_detailed: Kotler and other standard texts define the 4 Ps as the core controllable marketing variables. CSS and PMS Business Administration papers regularly test this list.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: In Maslow's hierarchy of needs, which need must be satisfied first before higher needs become motivating?
explanation_detailed: Food, shelter, and other basic survival needs sit at the base of the pyramid. Until these are reasonably met, higher needs rarely drive behaviour at work.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: According to Herzberg's two-factor theory, salary and working conditions are classified as:
explanation_detailed: Hygiene factors prevent dissatisfaction but do not by themselves create lasting motivation. Recognition and challenging work are motivators that build job satisfaction.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: Dividing a market on the basis of age, income, and family size is an example of:
explanation_detailed: Demographic variables are easy to measure and widely used in Pakistani consumer markets. Banks, telecom firms, and FMCG companies use them for target marketing.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: In the product life cycle, which stage is marked by slow sales growth and heavy promotional spending?
explanation_detailed: At introduction customers are still learning about the product and firms invest heavily in awareness. Profits are usually low or negative in this early stage.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: McGregor's Theory Y assumes that the average employee:
option_b: Can be self-directed and seeks responsibility under proper conditions
option_c: Needs constant close supervision to perform
option_d: Works only when threatened with punishment
explanation_detailed: Theory Y reflects a positive view of human nature at work. Managers who trust employees and delegate tend to align with this assumption.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: A push strategy in marketing primarily involves:
option_a: Persuading intermediaries to stock and promote the product
option_b: Building end-consumer demand through mass advertising alone
option_c: Selling exclusively through company-owned retail stores
option_d: Removing all wholesalers from the channel
explanation_detailed: Push strategy uses personal selling, trade discounts, and dealer incentives to move goods through the channel. Pull strategy focuses on creating consumer demand that pulls products off shelves.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: The Hawthorne studies conducted at Western Electric are chiefly remembered for showing that:
option_a: Scientific time study alone determines productivity
option_b: Formal rules always override informal group norms
option_c: Social and psychological factors strongly influence worker performance
option_d: Piece-rate pay is the only effective incentive
explanation_detailed: Researchers found that attention, group norms, and supervision affected output beyond physical working conditions. These findings helped launch the human relations school in management.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: In the STP framework, positioning means:
option_a: Choosing the factory location for production
option_b: Creating a distinct and favourable image of the offering in the target customer's mind
option_d: Recruiting and training the sales force
explanation_detailed: Segmentation divides the market, targeting selects the segments to serve, and positioning defines how the brand is perceived relative to competitors. Strong positioning supports competitive advantage.

subject: Business Administration
question_text: A leadership style in which the leader gives subordinates full freedom to make decisions is called:
explanation_detailed: Laissez-faire leaders provide minimal direction and rely on group self-management. It can work with highly skilled teams but may fail when members need clear guidance.
